pitch_routes.route: No official unsolicited-submissions page found today; treat as agent / established production company only.

briefs.title: Jenn Levy named Head of Unscripted and Documentary TV (TheWrap)
briefs.summary: New post overseeing all of the studio's unscripted work; reports to Peter Friedlander, who credited her with shows such as Love Is Blind, which she helped launch at Netflix.

briefs.title: Jenny Groom named Head of MGM Alternative (TheWrap)
briefs.summary: MGM Alternative will develop new formats and series for Prime Video and sell to other buyers.

commissioners.name: Jenn Levy
commissioners.title: Head of Unscripted and Documentary Television, Amazon MGM Studios
commissioners.remit: Oversees the studio's whole unscripted and documentary TV effort: Amazon MGM Unscripted, MGM Alternative, Big Fish Entertainment and Evolution Media report to her. Reports to Peter Friedlander, head of global TV. (TheWrap, Nov 2026, calls her 'Amazon MGM Studios Nonfiction Head'.)
commissioners.notes: No specific title found credited to her as commissioner.

commissioners.name: Ariane Wu
commissioners.title: Senior Creative Executive, Documentary Series
commissioners.remit: Documentary series; reports to Jenn Levy. Previously eight years at Netflix (director of original documentary film from 2020; The Tinder Swindler)
commissioners.notes: Most relevant Amazon contact for docuseries.

commissioners.name: Tiffany Faigus
commissioners.title: Senior Creative Executive, Unscripted Series
commissioners.remit: Unscripted series; reports to Jenn Levy. Ex-SVP unscripted and alternative at ABC / Walt Disney Television Alternative

commissioners.name: Jenny Groom
commissioners.title: Head of MGM Alternative
commissioners.remit: Legacy franchises Survivor, Shark Tank and The Voice plus the format library; developing new formats and series for Prime Video and sales to third-party buyers; reports to Jenn Levy. Starts 30 Nov 2026.
commissioners.notes: MGM Alternative is a studio/production arm that also sells to other networks - formats-focused, less relevant to docs.
